why: phase-492 W8 — the deserialiser slot of the type descriptor (`rclc_message_type_t::deserialize`, and the request/response/goal/result/feedback slots of the service and action descriptors): `(const uint8_t *buf, size_t len, void *msg) -> int32_t`, writing into caller-owned storage and refusing a field that does not fit its capacity. Generated per type as a REAL function with the erased signature (`<Msg>__nros_deserialize_erased`), never a cast of `<Msg>__deserialize`: calling through a mismatched function-pointer type is UB and CFI traps on it. rosidl has no counterpart because its type support carries a `func` dispatcher instead, which RFC-0089 declines to claim; the descriptor carries the codec directly so `rclc_executor_add_subscription_with_context` takes rclc's six arguments.
